tone.name: Dramatic
tone.description: High stakes and strong feelings. Family secrets, betrayal, and hard choices. Also covers melancholy and thriller stories.

goals.name: Uncover a spy
goals.description: Secrets leak from a closed group. Find the spy before the next leak.

goals.name: Prevent a heist
goals.description: A gang plans a robbery. Find the target, the time, and the inside person.

twists.name: Two culprits acting apart
twists.description: Two people each did part of it, without knowing about the other.

twists.name: The wrong victim
twists.description: The culprit targeted someone else, and the victim was a mistake.

twists.name: Identity swap
twists.description: Two people traded places, and the documents show small slips.

frames.name: The jury room
frames.description: You are the jury, and you review the exhibits of a trial.

frames.name: The smart house logs
frames.description: You read the logs of a home assistant from the night in question.

motifs.name: Music
motifs.puzzle_skins: Note letters on a staff, rhythm as Morse, and concert programs as timetables.

motifs.name: Birds
motifs.puzzle_skins: Bird ring numbers as codes, migration maps as routes, and bird songs as Morse transcripts.

plots: A stormy night in a gothic mansion, with a butler.
A rich old man poisoned at the reading of his will.
Poison in the wine glass at a dinner party.
The culprit is an evil twin that nobody mentioned.
The culprit has amnesia and did it without knowing.
The detective's long-lost relative is the culprit.
The famous riddle with a changed answer.
A secret passage that the floor plan never shows.

audience_rule.notes: Murder, fraud, and espionage. Easy to expert puzzles. Dense documents are fine. Gore only when the config asks for horror.

mechanics.name: Phone Keypad
mechanics.summary: Digits stand for the letters on an old phone keypad.

mechanics.name: Anachronism Hunt
mechanics.summary: A document holds impossible details that expose it as a forgery.

mechanics.name: Every Nth Letter
mechanics.summary: Every Nth letter of an ordinary text spells the hidden message.

mechanics.name: Shredded Document Strips
mechanics.summary: A message cut into strips goes back into order.

mechanics.name: Book Cipher Over Kit Documents
mechanics.summary: Number triples point to a document, a line, and a word in the kit.

mechanics.name: Arithmetic Lock
mechanics.summary: Numbers found in several documents combine by a stated formula into the lock code.

mechanics.name: Word Search With Leftover Message
mechanics.summary: Find the theme words, then the unused letters spell a message.

mechanics.name: Maze With Letters on the Path
mechanics.summary: Solve a maze, and the letters on the true path spell the answer.

mechanics.name: Whodunit Deduction
mechanics.summary: Players use all the evidence to name the culprit, the method, and the motive.

mechanics.name: Timeline Reconstruction
mechanics.summary: Order events from several sources, then find the gap or the impossible event.

mechanics.name: Vigenere With a Found Key
mechanics.summary: A keyword shifts each letter by a different amount, with a printed table to help.

mechanics.name: Detail Observation
mechanics.summary: A small detail in a document or picture (a price, a reflection, a stain) holds the answer.

mechanics.name: Anagram
mechanics.summary: The letters of a phrase rearrange into the answer.

mechanics.name: Cut-Out Mask (Cardan Grille)
mechanics.summary: A card with holes, laid over an innocent letter, shows only the letters of the message.

mechanics.name: Logic Grid
mechanics.summary: Clue statements fix one unique assignment of people to attributes, such as who wore what.

mechanics.name: Atbash Mirror Alphabet
mechanics.summary: The alphabet is flipped, so A becomes Z and B becomes Y.

mechanics.name: Clock Hands Code
mechanics.summary: Clock times encode digits, letters, or numbers to add.

mechanics.name: Rebus Picture Word
mechanics.summary: Pictures and letters combine by sound, so EYE plus LAND is ISLAND.

mechanics.name: Nonogram
mechanics.summary: Number clues for each row and column reveal a picture of a digit, letter, or object.

mechanics.name: Braille Dots
mechanics.summary: Groups of dots in a 2 by 3 cell spell letters in Braille.

mechanics.name: Re-Read With New Eyes
mechanics.summary: A document read early gains a new meaning after a later discovery.

mechanics.name: Acrostic Letter or Poem
mechanics.summary: The first letters of the sentences, lines, or paragraphs spell the answer.

mechanics.name: Riddle
mechanics.summary: A "what am I" verse whose answer is a word, often an object that unlocks the next step.

mechanics.name: Keyword Substitution Cryptogram
mechanics.summary: Each letter is always replaced by the same other letter, as in a newspaper cryptogram.
